# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 40 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_040_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 40

**1** Jesus said: "A vine was planted outside the Father. It has no strength. It will be pulled up root and all, and it will die."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "It has no strength" — the weakness rendered as a present condition
- "Root and all" — the totality of the uprooting
- "It will die" — the simple end; "perish" rendered as death

---
